def solve():
    N, K = map(int, input().split())
    has_snack = [False] * (N + 1)
    
    for _ in range(K):
        d = int(input())
        for _ in range(d):
            snuke = int(input())
            has_snack[snuke] = True
    
    victims = sum(1 for snuke in has_snack[1:] if not snuke)
    print(victims)
